'''Darth Victun''' was a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> and member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]]<ref name="Imperial Citadel" /> around [[4043 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> Victun and fellow Dark Council member<ref name="Imperial Citadel" /> [[Darth Qalar]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> fought a [[Kaggath (c. 4043 BBY)|violent]] [[Kaggath]], a ritual [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] duel, that obliterated the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When the two called a draw, both Qalar and Victun were [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the other members of the Dark Council,<ref name="Imperial Citadel" /> and their assets were used in the reconstruction while the two's [[Victun bloodline|family]] lines were eliminated.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Victun was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Imperial Citadel in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Imperial Citadel" /> though the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] name was not revealed until the release of the game's companion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia|''Encyclopedia'']].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
